target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
target_cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory. Common in: path_traversal, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Validate and sanitize all file paths and names
Use canonical path resolution and access controls
